sprint.name: CFN-* CLI Naming Pattern Standardization and Testing
sprint.description: Standardize all CLI commands to use cfn-* pattern, fix CLI parameter handling, and validate agent spawning works end-to-end

cli_architecture_gap.issue: cfn-spawn currently wraps spawn-workers.cjs which expects --agent/--task/--mode params but spawns 'npx claude' processes recursively, not agent processes
cli_architecture_gap.required_fix: cfn-spawn needs proper 'agent' subcommand that directly spawns agent processes, not worker spawners
cli_architecture_gap.impact: Medium - orchestrator reverted to npx claude-flow-novice agent pattern for now
cli_architecture_gap.resolution_plan: Implement proper CLI routing in spawn.ts to handle 'agent' subcommand correctly
cli_architecture_gap.resolution_implemented: Wrapper approach - cfn-spawn delegates to npx claude-flow-novice agent for compatibility while providing desired naming pattern

architecture.agent_profiles_not_executable: Agent profiles (.md files) are prompt templates for Task() tool, not standalone executable scripts. CLI spawning requires delegation to existing mechanisms.
architecture.wrapper_pattern_effective: Creating wrapper CLIs that delegate to working implementations is faster and safer than reimplementing core functionality.
architecture.legacy_code_invaluable: Legacy implementation showed actual working patterns - spawned 'claude' CLI with prompts, not standalone agent execution.

implementation.pragmatic_over_perfect: Wrapper solution (4 hours) vs full reimplementation (20+ hours). Wrapper provides 90% of benefits with 20% of effort.
implementation.bulk_automation_powerful: Bulk sed commands updated 25+ files in seconds. Manual updates would have taken hours and introduced errors.
implementation.es_module_gotchas: require.main === module doesn't work in ES modules. Use import.meta.url comparison instead.

testing.help_system_first: Implementing --help flag first validates argument parsing before testing actual functionality.
testing.dry_run_pattern: Test argument parsing with timeout/dry-run before full execution to catch errors early.
testing.orchestrator_as_integration_test: Orchestrator script serves as real-world integration test for CLI spawning.

documentation.bulk_replace_safe: When pattern is consistent (npx claude-flow-novice agent → npx cfn-spawn agent), bulk sed is safer than manual edits.
documentation.exclude_self_references: Sprint config and investigation docs intentionally kept old patterns for historical accuracy.
documentation.grep_filters_critical: Excluding train agent, agents list, etc. prevented breaking unrelated commands.

time_management.investigation_time_valuable: 1 hour investigating legacy code saved 3+ hours of wrong implementation.
time_management.incremental_validation: Test after each step (help → args → delegation) catches issues early vs big-bang testing.
time_management.actual_vs_estimated: 4 hours actual vs 4.5-5.5 hours estimated (12% under budget due to wrapper approach)
